issues.what: Three definition-vs-code mismatches, none a leak: (a) the gf_lib docstring (FINDINGS section 2) says the bagging base tree is DecisionTreeClassifier(..., class_weight balanced) but BagLearner passes no class_weight — class balance comes only from make_weights (so the doc, not the code, is wrong; adding it would double-balance); (b) distillation is defined as fitting to 'the learner's inner-CV decisions on the training rows', which holds for hgbc / hgbr (keep_tr = inner >= tau) and bag4 (OOB), but for the scorecard keep_tr = p_tr >= tau where p_tr is the refit model's in-sample score on the training rows mapped through the Platt fit — training rows only, no test-fold contact, but not the inner-CV decision the definition states; (c) results/oof_<tf>.parquet: for hgbr the `p` (and `tau`) columns hold E[net|x] in INR, not a probability; FINDINGS only warns that p is NaN for the policy learners, so the downstream operating-point / sizing agent can misread it.
